description: This file defines the 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' class, a Java class implementing the 'LogNode' interface. It functions as a filter for logging, passing only the message content while suppressing other metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that passes only log messages, useful for simplified on-screen logging display.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that takes a LogNode as the next node in the logging chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log entries, passing only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which logs will be passed.
